product_one_liner.value: CompanyCam is a photo-documentation and jobsite-communication platform that helps contractors and field-service teams document work, track progress, and keep field and office teams connected.
product_one_liner.notes: CompanyCam’s About page describes the app’s contractor audience and job documentation/communication use.
